name: Hilltop cottages
description: Extremely limited, high-end VVIP suites and cottages. Overnight stays on the hilltop are highly restricted for the general public.

name: YTDA Divya Sannidhi Cottages
description: Located at the foothills. These are premium, modern villa-style cottages designed for families, priced at approximately ₹3,000 per night. Bookable online via the official YTDA portal (ytda.in / ytdabooking.in).

name: Temple Satralu & Guest Houses (Yogananda Nilayam)
description: Located at the foothills. Clean, basic, and budget-friendly rooms. Yogananda Nilayam booking counter contact: 08685-236664.

name: Haritha Hotel Yadagirigutta (Telangana Tourism)
description: Located at the foothills near the main TGRTC bus stand. Managed by TSTDC, it features standard AC/Non-AC rooms, family deluxe suites, and an on-site vegetarian restaurant. Direct phone: 08685-293217, Mobile: 96669-82023. Bookable via tgtdc.in or tourism.telangana.gov.in.

name: Mani Residency
description: Basic lodging with an AC convention hall.
